# dsh-nethack
[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@yeaszn/dsh-neth4ck) [](LICENSE) [](https://github.com/topics/dsh-p
ps://www.npmjs.com/package/@yeaszn/dsh-neth4ck) [](LICENSE) [](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
Maintained by @yeasen-z
**Play NetHack in natural language, inside DeepSeek Harness (DSH).**

The game runs the real NetHack 3.6.7 engine (WASM). You and an AI partner drive the
same character i

n the same game session — play it yourself with the on-screen pad,
or hand the character to the mode
l and talk to it in an ordinary DSH conversation.

**Requirements:** DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0` (`engines.dsh`; only 0.2.1-rc.3 has been
exercised). A c

onfigured model is needed only for the AI partner; the manual
controls work without one.
## 1. Quick install from npm
Package: **`@yeaszn/dsh-neth4ck`** (the current release is `0.2.2`).
In DSH, open **Plugins → Add plugin** and enter:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Approve the install, enable **both** the NetHack plugin and its `nethack` preset,
refresh DSH, then
open the **@ / NetHack** panel.

- The package is published as `dsh-neth4ck` because npm refuses new names that
contain `nethack`. In

side DSH it is still called NetHack.
- If you get `404 Not Found`, your install source mirror has no

t synced the package
yet (for example `registry.npmmirror.com`). Switch to **npm official**, or wait

a
few minutes and retry.
- Only one copy of this plugin can be installed at a time. To change versi

ons,
uninstall first.

The plugin market also lists it: **Plugins → Discover → Add index source**, paste
`https://raw.githu

busercontent.com/yeasen-z/dsh-nethack/main/plugins/dsh-nethack/market/index.json`,
then search for e

ither `nethack` or the exact package name `@yeaszn/dsh-neth4ck`
(search covers the entry's `name`, s
o the full package name matches directly).

Both entries route through DSH's own npm handling: **Add plugin** with a package
name and the market

's install button fetch the same published tarball, so pick
whichever you reach first.
## 2. Local development from git clone
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then, in a DSH session, ask:
> Install the local bundle at `/absolute/path/to/dsh-nethack/plugins/dsh-nethack` using the plugin m
anager. Enable both the NetHack plugin and its nethack agent preset.

To update after you change code, pull (`git pull --ff-only`) or edit, then ask DSH
to reinstall the
same local bundle and restart DSH.

Do not symlink the bundle into your DSH profile by hand, and do not install the whole
repository as

an npm package. The installable unit is `plugins/dsh-nethack`. Run the
tests with `node plugins/dsh-
nethack/tests/<name>.mjs`.

To pin a released commit instead of a clone, use the git source in
`market/index.json` (`versions[0]

.source.commit`). Pin a full SHA, because a branch
would change under you.
## 3. What it is for

**Play it yourself.** Use the direction pad, verbs and free-key field in the
console, the pack tab f
or inventory, and the message log. No model is required.

**Let an agent play it.** The game is an environment an LLM agent can observe and
act in, with the s
ame controls and the same character as the human:

- observe the map, status and inventory;
- propose typed actions, or run a bounded skill such as wal

king to a target;
- hand control back and forth. Stop revokes the agent's permission immediately, so
late actions from an earlier turn never run.

The human and the agent share one game. This makes the project useful both as a
companion to play wi

th and as a gaming environment for studying agent behaviour.
The contracts are described in the deve
loper reference below.
## Limits

- One live game per Host process. Quitting DSH ends the in-memory game; chat history
is not a saved

NetHack game.
- Model calls use your configured provider and may incur charges.
## Middleware library (developer reference)

The plugin is built on a middleware library that exposes NetHack as an
environment that humans and L

LM agents can control. You do not need this section
to play; it describes the contracts, invariants

and test harness under
`packages/`, `apps/` and `eval/`.
## 1. Architecture
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Key invariants (enforced by code, not documentation):
| Invariant | Where enforced |
| **One write path** into the runtime; all inputs serialize through one scheduler | `packages/core/s

rc/scheduler.ts` |
| **Observations are player-visible only**; visible vs. remembered tiles distingu
ished; uncertainty preserved (`null` = unknown) | `packages/adapter-wasm/src/fake-runtime.ts`, `pack

ages/core/src/session.ts` |
| **`observe()` never advances game time** | contract + `eval/harness.mt

s` acceptance case |
| **Control epochs**: late proposals/actions from an older epoch never execute

| `packages/core/src/control.ts` |
| **Stale/duplicate/unsupported requests cause zero runtime input

**; duplicate request IDs return the prior result | `packages/core/src/session.ts` |
| **Skills issu
e one step at a time**, recheck state after each action, honor budgets and stop rules | `packages/sk

ills/src/walk-to.ts` |
| **Malformed model output => explanation, no runtime input** | `packages/age
nt/src/orchestrate.ts` |
## 2. Repository Layout
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Workspace packages use the `@nhchat/*` scope. `apps/web` imports only `@nhchat/*` public entry point
s - it never touches the runtime directly, satisfying the "client independence" acceptance criterion
- it never touches the runtime directly, satisfying the "client independence" acceptance criterion.
## 3. Public Middleware API (`@nhchat/core`)
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Typed actions (the model may only propose these):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Step statuses: `completed | rejected | needs_input | cancelled | game_over`. Requests carry `expecte
d_state_version` and `control_epoch`; anything stale is rejected **before** touching the runtime.
Interaction modes (separate from execution ownership - only one controller writes at a time): `human
`, `suggest`, `approval`, `delegated`, `agent` (reserved).
